newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bourse lowers requirements for foreign board.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bourse lowers requirements for foreign board.

text.p: The Stock Exchange of Singapore (SES) has lower the mininum requirement for regional infrastructure companies interested in a listing, Finance Minister Richard Hu said on Friday.

Hu told a seminar in Tokyu the SES decided to revise the mininum project size for a listing on the foreign board to Singapore $150 million from S$300 million. The text of his remarks was issued in Singapore.
He said the exchange made the changes after reviewing the projects of some of the infrastructure companies which have expressed interest in listing on the foreign board.

"The SES will also consider approving the listing of an infrastructure company if the aggregate project cost for all its projects is at least S$150 million, nothwithstanding that each of the projects may be less than S$150 million," Hu said.
He said the new criterion recognises the region's need for new infrastructure.
